title: How Praying Over Lunch in Public Builds a Godly Man Who's the Same Everywhere
caption:
At home you pray before you eat. At the work lunch or the food court with friends, you just start eating.

Nobody told you to stop. You just didn't want to look weird. And that small hesitation is where the split starts: one version of you for home, another for everywhere else.

Praying over your food in public won't make you holy. But it does something quiet. It makes you the same man in every room. And once you're that guy at lunch, it gets a lot harder to be a different guy at night.

"Always be prepared to give an answer to everyone who asks you to give the reason for the hope that you have. But do this with gentleness and respect." 1 Peter 3:15

Save this. Try it at your next lunch out.
